text:
Customer (Acme Labs): Hey team — we accepted the AWS Accelerator grant last week but the credits still show as 'pending approval' in the console and our account balance is unchanged. Trying to run inference and getting a billing error. Can someone check?

Priya M: Sorry about that, leaving this with billing. Do you have the AWS order id / Marketplace transaction id?

Customer (Acme Labs): Order id is 123-4567890-ABC, marketplace entitlement id arn:aws:marketplace:us-east-1::entitlement/acc-0123456789. Our Redwood account id is rwd_987654.

Josh L: Thanks — can you paste the exact error you see when hitting the API? A snippet helps.

Customer (Acme Labs): API returns HTTP 402 with body: `{\n  "error": "insufficient_funds",\n  "detail": "no active promotional credits: account rwd_987654"\n}`

Alex H: Billing Bot, can you run entitlement-sync for rwd_987654 and check marketplace link?

Billing Bot: Running entitlement-sync --account rwd_987654 --provider aws --tx 123-4567890-ABC
Billing Bot: Result: entitlement record found but status=AWAITING_VENDOR_APPROVAL; last_update=2026-02-28T14:03:22Z

Priya M: Ah — AWS side still shows vendor approval pending. That can happen for accelerator grants if partner needs to accept. I'm going to ping Partner Ops.

Partner Ops Bot: Noted. Reaching out to AWS Partner team with entitlement id acc-0123456789. ETA 4 business hours.

Josh L: In the meantime you can use a temporary promo credit if you need to unblock testing. Would you like a short-term credit of $200 while we wait?

Customer (Acme Labs): That would help, thanks. Also can you confirm whether the entitlement should auto-apply once AWS flips to ACTIVE, or is there a manual step on our side?

Alex H: Once AWS marks the entitlement ACTIVE, our entitlement-sync job should pick it up and create a credit ledger entry automatically. Occasionally the webhook delivery fails and we need to re-run the reconciliation job. If Partner Ops confirms ACTIVE, we'll re-run reconciliation and post the credit.

Priya M: Opened support ticket RWD-2026-1122 for the sync + manual reconciliation. Assigned to Josh and Partner Ops. Action items: 1) Partner Ops: confirm approval with AWS and request immediate activation. 2) Billing: re-run reconciliation and post credits to rwd_987654 when ACTIVE. 3) Support: apply temporary promo $200 to unblock.

Josh L: I've applied promo code TEMP-ACME-200 — should show under Billing > Credits within a few minutes. Use it against API calls.

Customer (Acme Labs): Promo showed up, thanks. Please keep me posted on AWS approval so we can retire the temp credit.

Partner Ops Bot: AWS partner team replied: vendor acknowledged, pushing entitlement to ACTIVE. Confirming once we see notify webhook.

Billing Bot: Webhook received: entitlement acc-0123456789 status=ACTIVE timestamp=2026-02-28T18:22:05Z. Queuing reconciliation job.

Billing Bot: Reconciliation complete. Credit posted: $5,000 marketplace accelerator grant applied to rwd_987654. Temp promo set to expire on 2026-03-05 (unused balance removed).

Priya M: All set. Customer, confirm you can now run your job without 402.

Customer (Acme Labs): Confirmed — no 402s now, grant appears in billing. Really appreciate the quick help and the temp credit.

Alex H: Filing short postmortem note in #support-runbook: add check to detect long AWAITING_VENDOR_APPROVAL states and auto-escalate after 48h.

Priya M: Closing thread once ticket RWD-2026-1122 marked resolved. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
